# Contributing

This guide is for the kortx framework repository. An instance gets this file with the framework updates.

## Issues

- Write one idea in each issue.
- Use the issue forms: "Problem" or "Proposal".
- Give a real case. Use generic names, for example `acme` for a client.
- To write the draft from an instance, use the `draft-framework-issue` skill. The skill removes the private data. You open the issue.

## Pull requests

- Open an issue before you open a pull request.
- Make one pull request for each issue.
- Run the check before you push. See "Check" in `README.md`.
- Write the commit messages with the `commit` skill.

## Text

- Write all text in English with the ASD-STE100 rules. Use the `write-docs` skill.

## Private data

- Never write private data of an instance in an issue, a pull request, a commit message or a file. See "Data in the framework" in `kortx/requirements.md`.

## License

You give your contribution under the license of the framework. See "License" in `README.md`.
